Rulings in force: site-masthead:ruling:operator-chromeless-column; the wash-home-only authority map (no second wash token, no class toggled by script, no page rule setting a radial alpha). Re-pin base to main after wash-home-only lands; line numbers below are from 535d170 and shift; re-read by selector.

Aetheria reference, read once, copy nothing: Raymarching/CloudShader.shader IntegrateRaymarch (:83-104) for the transmittance integration; its pass 2 (:261-314) for what not to do (gamma 0.5 variance clip, fixed 0.05 blend, packed depth, the density2 bug at :311). Volumetric.cginc for the fill+coverage structure only.

Engine facts to confirm before writing: how GameCult-Quartz (sibling checkout or GAMECULT_QUARTZ_ROOT) bundles a component's afterDOMLoaded (esbuild) and whether a dynamic import() of /static/ground/ground.js is allowed, else a module script tag emitted from the component; that site/quartz/static/** is served at /static/**; enableSPA is false (quartz.config.ts:15) so a route change is a page load. Local build: scripts/quartz/quartz.ps1 dev.

Tokens (Q3 a): declare on body beside --gamecult-wash: --gamecult-ground-0/1/2 (#03070d #07111a #09141f), and for N in 0..2: --gamecult-light-N ("255 138 42" / "109 96 255" / "89 183 255"), --gamecult-light-N-a (0.18/0.16/0.14), --gamecult-light-N-at ("78% 14%" / "18% 10%" / "52% 0%"), --gamecult-light-N-r (18% / 24% / 28%). The body background becomes radial-gradient(circle at var(--gamecult-light-0-at), rgb(var(--gamecult-light-0) / calc(var(--gamecult-light-0-a) * var(--gamecult-wash))), transparent var(--gamecult-light-0-r)) x3 over linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gamecult-ground-0) 0%, var(--gamecult-ground-1) 44%, var(--gamecult-ground-2) 100%). The ritual block (custom.scss:119-124) overrides the fifteen tokens with its values (yellow 255 178 30 .15 at 78% 8% 24rem; cobalt 49 88 255 .22 at 18% 4% 30rem; violet 91 54 184 .19 at 44% 20% 34rem; stops #030414 0%, #070b24 42%, #040514 100%) and its own background declaration is deleted; it inherits body's.

ground.js owns: WebGL2 context on #gamecult-ground (alpha:false, antialias:false, powerPreference 'low-power'); capability check (WebGL2, EXT_color_buffer_half_float or float); token read via getComputedStyle(document.body) -> uniforms, resolving % radii as CSS does (circle, farthest-corner of the background positioning area) and rem/px lengths via the root font size; two RGBA16F history targets; the march pass and the resolve pass; the scheduler (30 fps cadence while accumulating or drifting, visibilityState pause, reduced-motion stop at 32 frames); the budget controller; the debug flag (?ground=debug) that logs measurements and switches the march to evals/unfinished output.

Budget controller, one function, one state machine: measure GPU time per frame with EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 when present, else a fenceSync after the resolve polled to completion, else rAF cadence. Over a 60-frame window: if the median exceeds the budget (4.0 ms), step down: S 16 -> 8 -> 4, then dpr -> 1 (Q2 a), then remove the canvas (CSS wash). Never step up within a session. A median rising 50% over 5 minutes also steps down (thermal). No storage, no userAgent, no maxTouchPoints.

cloud.frag.glsl: #version 300 es; precision highp float; precision highp int; then the vendored CultMath.glsl is concatenated by ground.js before this file's body. The field, march and integration exactly as the map's pseudocode; uniforms: resolution, time, frame, jitter, S, intensity, three lights (rgb, alpha, centre px, radius px), three stops, Z0/Z1, F0, CUTOFF, K, drift. The output luminance clamp at 0.035. taa.frag.glsl: history + current, 3x3 min/max clamp, alpha = max(1/frames, 1/32), writes the new history and the screen in one pass via drawBuffers or two cheap draws.

Vendoring (D3): site/quartz/static/ground/CultMath.glsl is byte-equal to CultLib shaders/CultMath.glsl at the commit named in its first line (a comment: generated by CultLib <sha>). A script scripts/ground/check-cultmath-glsl.ps1 diffs the vendored file against git show <sha>:packages/cultmath/shaders/CultMath.glsl from a CultLib checkout and exits non-zero on drift; Hands runs it in the report.

Parity on the device (closes the GLSL leg of the proving ground): with ?ground=parity, ground.js evaluates the fixture from CultLib tests/CultMath.Tests/fixtures/glsl-parity.json (vendored beside CultMath.glsl, same pin) in a 1-pixel-per-point pass, reads back float bit patterns, and reports per function the max ulp distance and the count outside the fixture's tolerance class. Hands runs it in the browser pane and quotes the numbers and the GPU/driver string.

Prove in the browser pane: readback of the max relative luminance over the canvas after 32 frames on / at intensity 1 (<= 0.035); the token parity probe (density forced to 0: canvas vs CSS wash at 16 points within 2/255, on / and on a ritual essay); the debug readback (mean evals per pixel and unfinished-ray fraction < 1%); GPU ms per pass with the timer query at the pane's desktop size and at the mobile preset's pixel count. Phone GPU time is operator verification.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss body tokens own the ground's colours, lights and intensity; ground.js owns scheduling, budget and TAA; cloud.frag.glsl owns the field; CultLib owns every noise and interval function the field calls.
inputs: measured GPU frame time (timer query, fence, or rAF cadence)
the vendored CultMath.glsl at its pinned CultLib commit
outputs: one opaque canvas under the page, luminance <= 0.035, identical to the CSS wash at zero density
debug and parity readbacks (console, flag only)
derived_state: every uniform colour, position, radius and the intensity are derived from the tokens; the shader holds no colour
the TAA history is a cache; reset on resize and first frame
S and dpr are derived from measurement within the session; never stored
CultMath.glsl in the site is derived from CultLib at the pinned commit; the drift check pins it
forbidden_writers: no colour, alpha, position or radius literal in ground.js or any GLSL file
no navigator.userAgent, platform, maxTouchPoints, or any device-name branch
no class or attribute set on body or html by ground.js; no second wash token; no page rule setting a radial alpha
no noise or interval function defined in the site's GLSL; only cultmath_* calls
no localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies; no setInterval; one requestAnimationFrame scheduler
shared_paths: home, every content page and the ritual essays paint through the same tokens in CSS and in the shader
slow device, hidden tab, reduced motion, missing WebGL2 and missing half-float all pass through the one controller
the same Deploy Quartz workflow; static files ship with the overlay
authority_map.deletion_line: The ritual block's own background and the nine body literals go in the same commit the tokens are declared. The canvas, the two shaders, ground.js and the vendored library are the whole addition; nothing else in the engine or the content changes.
